---
title: "03b - Join carbon change data with plot-level covariates"
output: html_document
params:
  c_data_name: agc_change
---

**Purpose.** Joins plot-level carbon *change* (accumulation rate, Mg C/ha/yr)
data for one carbon pool with site covariates (sites table: country,
climate/elevation, SoilGrids texture, Audebert ecoregions), plot covariates (01), a
derived IPCC climate region, and species-level trait data. Comma-separated
categorical fields are converted into dummy variables, and min/mean/max stand
age of each change interval is computed. This is the carbon-change counterpart
of 03a. The carbon pool is selected with the `c_data_name` YAML parameter
(`'agc_change'`, `'bgc_change'`, or `'soc_change'`); the notebook processes
one pool per run, so it must be run three times (once per pool) to produce all
outputs. `run_all.R` does this automatically.

**Inputs.**

- `output/data/agc_change_by_plot_and_age.xlsx` (02a), if `c_data_name == 'agc_change'`
- `output/data/bgc_change_by_plot_and_age.xlsx` (02b), if `c_data_name == 'bgc_change'`
- `output/intermediate/soc_data_out_c_t_ha_norm_30.xlsx` (02c), if `c_data_name == 'soc_change'`
- `output/intermediate/s3_by_plot.xlsx` (01)
- `data/groa_af/sites.csv` (GROA-AF dataset)
- `data/species_trait_data.csv` (species traits from TRY)

**Outputs.**

- `output/data/<c_data_name>_by_plot_and_age_w_covars.xlsx`, i.e.
  `agc_change_`, `bgc_change_`, or `soc_change_by_plot_and_age_w_covars.xlsx`
  depending on the run

```{r setup}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

```

Options. Set the `c_data_name` parameter (YAML header) to the carbon pool to
process and re-run the notebook for each of the three pools, or render with
`rmarkdown::render(..., params = list(c_data_name = 'bgc_change'))`.

```{r options}

# valid options: 'agc_change' (aboveground), 'bgc_change' (belowground), 'soc_change' (soil organic carbon)
c_data_name <- params$c_data_name
stopifnot(c_data_name %in% c('agc_change', 'bgc_change', 'soc_change'))

af_cats <- c('AC', 'BP', 'COP', 'FAL', 'FOD', 'MS', 'OTH_AF', 'PAR', 'RB', 'ROT', 'SA', 'SP', 'SPC', 'TMC', 'WL')

```

Load the carbon change data for the selected pool and the covariate datasets.
```{r load-data}

if (c_data_name %in% c('agc_change', 'bgc_change')) {
  c_df <- read.xlsx(paste0(here("output", "data"), "/", c_data_name, '_by_plot_and_age.xlsx')) 
} else if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  c_df <- read.xlsx(paste0(here("output", "intermediate", "soc_data_out_c_t_ha_norm_30.xlsx"))) %>%
    filter(sc_flag == '') %>% # filter out cases where pc/sr soil comp failed
    select(ssp_id, c_t_ha_yr, af_cat, age_yrs, age_yrs_prev_chron, ctrl_cat, depth_min, depth_max)
}

s3_df <- read.xlsx(here("output", "intermediate", "s3_by_plot.xlsx"))

# Site covariates from the GROA-AF dataset. masl/map/mat are harmonized there:
# the study value (midpoint of ranges) or, where not reported, the WorldClim /
# elevation backfill. SoilGrids texture is used below where plot-level texture is
# missing. Ecoregions come from the Audebert et al. (2024) zones.
s2_df <- read.csv(here("data", "groa_af", "sites.csv"), na.strings = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
                  colClasses = c(site_id = "character")) %>%
  select(site_id, country, masl, map, mat,
         sand_bf = sand_pct_soilgrids, silt_bf = silt_pct_soilgrids,
         clay_bf = clay_pct_soilgrids, tex_class_bf = soil_texture_class_soilgrids,
         audebert_zone, ecoregion = audebert_ecoregion_5class)

```

Helper functions for parsing numeric strings (e.g. ranges like "10 to 20") and for cleaning comma-separated lists.
```{r helpers}

parse_num <- function (num_str) {
  num_str <- num_str %>% str_remove('<') %>% str_remove('>')
  if (is.na(num_str) || num_str == '') {
    return(NA)
  } else if (!is.na(as.numeric(num_str))) {
    return(as.numeric(num_str))
  } else if (grepl('to', num_str)) {
    num_strs <- num_str %>%
      str_split_1('to') %>%
      trimws()
    return(mean(c(as.numeric(num_strs[1]), as.numeric(num_strs[2]))))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# function to compile comma-separated lists of data for output
make_csl <- function(vec) {
  csl_all <- paste0(vec, collapse = ', ')
  vec <- str_split_1(csl_all, pattern = ', ') %>%
    trimws() %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  vec <- vec[!is.na(vec) & vec != 'NA' & vec != '']
  return (paste0(vec, collapse = ', '))
}

filter_prior_cats <- function(str, prior_cat_vec = valid_prior_cats) {
  vec <- str_split_1(str, pattern = ', ')
  vec <- vec[vec %in% prior_cat_vec]
  return (paste0(vec, collapse = ', '))
}


```


Join the plot covariates (01) and site covariates (sites table) to the carbon data.
```{r merge}

s2_df_merge <- s2_df

# special case for soc chronosequences, because could have multiple plots
# workaround - use the first ssp_id that is present in s3_df for joins
# (the first listed plot is not always in s3_df, which dropped all site covariates)
# should be ok since covar data should be consistent between chronos
pick_first_csl <- function(csl_str) {
  elements <- str_split_1(csl_str, ', ') %>% trimws()
  in_s3 <- elements[elements %in% s3_df$ssp_id]
  return (if (length(in_s3) > 0) in_s3[1] else elements[1])
}
if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  c_df <- c_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(ssp_id_mult = ssp_id,
           ssp_id = pick_first_csl(ssp_id))
}

comb_df <- c_df %>%
  left_join(s3_df %>% select(-af_cat), by = "ssp_id") %>% # drop the af_cat duplicate
  left_join(s2_df_merge, by = "site_id") %>%
  arrange(ssp_id) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())


```


# Codify IPCC climate region using MAP/MAT/MASL
See https://www.ipcc-nggip.iges.or.jp/public/2019rf/corrigenda1.html and https://www.ipcc-nggip.iges.or.jp/public/2019rf/pdf/4_Volume4/19R_V4_Ch03_Land%20Representation.pdf for methods.
Using simplified methods to generate categories found in https://www.ipcc-nggip.iges.or.jp/public/gpglulucf/gpglulucf_files/Chp3/Chp3_3_Cropland.pdf, Table 3.3.2.
```{r ipcc-region}

gen_ipcc_reg <- function(mat, map, masl) {
  if (any(is.na(c(mat, map, masl)))) {
    return(NA)
  }
  if (mat > 18) {
    if (masl > 1000) {
      return('tropical_montane')
    }
    if (map > 2000) {
      return ('tropical_wet')
    }
    if (map > 1000) {
      return('tropical_moist')
    }
    return('tropical_dry')
  }
  if (mat > 0) {
    return ('temperate')
  }
  return ('boreal/polar')
}

comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ipcc_reg = gen_ipcc_reg(mat, map, masl))


```


Backfill soil texture percents and class where missing.
```{r soil-tex-backfill}

comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(soil_texture_class = 
           ifelse(is.na(soil_texture_class) || soil_texture_class == '', 
                  tex_class_bf, soil_texture_class),
         sand_pct_mean = coalesce(sand_pct_mean, sand_bf),
         silt_pct_mean = coalesce(silt_pct_mean, silt_bf),
         clay_pct_mean = coalesce(clay_pct_mean, clay_bf)) %>%
  select(-c(tex_class_bf, sand_bf, silt_bf, clay_bf))

```


Merge prior land-use categories (`prior_land_use`) with the year-0 AF category (`af_cat_y0`, AGC/BGC only) and keep only valid prior categories.
```{r prior-cats}

valid_prior_cats <- s3_df %>% pull(prior_land_use) %>% unique() %>% make_csl() %>% str_split_1(pattern = ', ')


if (c_data_name %in% c('agc_change', 'bgc_change')) {
  af_cats_y0 <- c_df %>% pull(af_cat_y0) %>% unique() %>% make_csl() %>% str_split_1(pattern = ', ')
  valid_prior_cats <- make_csl(c(valid_prior_cats, af_cats_y0)) %>% str_split_1(pattern = ', ')
}

valid_prior_cats <- valid_prior_cats[valid_prior_cats != 'NO_MATCH']

if (c_data_name %in% c('agc_change', 'bgc_change')) {
comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(prior_land_use = make_csl(c(prior_land_use, af_cat_y0)))
}

comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(prior_land_use = make_csl(prior_land_use)) %>%
  mutate(prior_land_use = filter_prior_cats(prior_land_use))

```

Convert comma-separated categorical columns to dummy variables.
```{r dummy-vars}

# prior land use
comb_df_prior_dummy <- comb_df %>%
  select(row_id, prior_land_use) %>%
  separate_rows(prior_land_use, sep = ", ") %>%
  mutate(prior_land_use = trimws(prior_land_use)) %>%
  filter(prior_land_use != "") %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prior_land_use, values_from = value, 
              values_fill = NA, names_prefix = "prior_")

# control (for SOC only)
if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  comb_df_ctrl_dummy <- comb_df %>%
    select(row_id, ctrl_cat) %>%
    separate_rows(ctrl_cat, sep = ", ") %>%
    mutate(ctrl_cat = trimws(ctrl_cat)) %>%
    filter(ctrl_cat != "") %>%
    mutate(value = 1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ctrl_cat, values_from = value, 
                values_fill = NA, names_prefix = "ctrl_")
}

# soil texture
comb_df_soiltex_dummy <- comb_df %>%
  select(row_id, soil_texture_class) %>%
  separate_rows(soil_texture_class, sep = ", ") %>%
  mutate(soil_texture_class = trimws(soil_texture_class)) %>%
  filter(soil_texture_class != "") %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = soil_texture_class, values_from = value, 
              values_fill = NA, names_prefix = "soil_tex_")

```

Join species trait data (from the TRY database), averaging continuous traits across all AF species in each plot.
```{r species-traits}

trait_df <- read.csv(here("data", "species_trait_data.csv"))

for (i in 1:nrow(comb_df)) {
  my_row <- comb_df[i,]
  if (! is.na(my_row$species_af)) {
    my_specs <- my_row$species_af %>% str_split_1(', ') %>% trimws()
    my_specs_trait_df <- trait_df %>% filter(AccSpeciesName %in% my_specs)
    comb_df[i,'avg_veg_height_m'] <- mean(my_specs_trait_df$veg_height_m, na.rm = T) %>% round(2)
    comb_df[i,'avg_wood_dens_g_cm3'] <- mean(my_specs_trait_df$wood_dens_g_cm3, na.rm = T) %>% round(2)
    comb_df[i,'avg_leaf_area_mm2_mg'] <- mean(my_specs_trait_df$leaf_area_mm2_mg, na.rm = T) %>% round(2)
    comb_df[i,'avg_root_depth_m'] <- mean(my_specs_trait_df$root_depth_m, na.rm = T) %>% round(2)
    comb_df[i,'n_fix_bin'] <- ifelse('Yes' %in% my_specs_trait_df$n_fix_bin, 1, 
                                     ifelse('No' %in% my_specs_trait_df$n_fix_bin, 0,
                                            NA))
    comb_df[i,'myco_fungi_am'] <- ifelse('Yes' %in% my_specs_trait_df$myco_fungi_am, 1, 
                                         ifelse('No' %in% my_specs_trait_df$myco_fungi_am, 0,
                                                NA))
    comb_df[i,'myco_fungi_ecm'] <- ifelse('Yes' %in% my_specs_trait_df$myco_fungi_ecm, 1, 
                                          ifelse('No' %in% my_specs_trait_df$myco_fungi_ecm, 0,
                                                 NA))
    comb_df[i,'freezing_exposed'] <- ifelse('Yes' %in% my_specs_trait_df$freezing_exposed, 1, 
                                            ifelse('No' %in% my_specs_trait_df$freezing_exposed, 0,
                                                   NA))
    comb_df[i,'resprout_after_fire'] <- ifelse('Yes' %in% my_specs_trait_df$resprout_after_fire, 1, 
                                               ifelse('No' %in% my_specs_trait_df$resprout_after_fire, 0,
                                                      NA))
  }
}

```

Compute min/mean/max stand age of each change interval, select the output columns for the selected pool, add the dummy variables, and write the combined dataset.
```{r final-output}

# interpret ages for soc_change
if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  comb_df <- comb_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(age_max = age_yrs,
           age_min = ifelse(is.na(age_yrs_prev_chron), 0, age_yrs_prev_chron))
}

comb_df <- comb_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(age_mean = mean(c(age_min, age_max)))

# select fields specific to c_data type
if (c_data_name == 'agc_change') {
  final_df <- comb_df %>%
    select(row_id, ssp_id, c_t_ha_yr, source,
           af_cat, age_min, age_mean, age_max, prior_land_use,
           country,
           ipcc_reg, audebert_zone, ecoregion,
           trees_per_ha = trees_per_ha_mean, 
           masl, map, mat, 
           soil_texture_class,
           sand_pct = sand_pct_mean,
           silt_pct = silt_pct_mean,
           clay_pct = clay_pct_mean, 
           af_diversity = af_diversity_mean,
           species_af,
           genera_af,
           pruning, weed_control, tillage, 
           pest_control, burning, litter_management, 
           fertilizer, irrigation, grazing,
           avg_veg_height_m, avg_wood_dens_g_cm3,
           avg_leaf_area_mm2_mg, avg_root_depth_m,
           n_fix_bin, myco_fungi_am, myco_fungi_ecm,
           freezing_exposed, resprout_after_fire)
} else if (c_data_name == 'bgc_change') {
  final_df <- comb_df %>%
    select(row_id, ssp_id, c_t_ha_yr, source,
           depth_min, depth_max,
           af_cat, age_min, age_mean, age_max, prior_land_use,
           country,
           ipcc_reg, audebert_zone, ecoregion,
           trees_per_ha = trees_per_ha_mean, 
           masl, map, mat, 
           soil_texture_class,
           sand_pct = sand_pct_mean,
           silt_pct = silt_pct_mean,
           clay_pct = clay_pct_mean, 
           af_diversity = af_diversity_mean,
           species_af,
           genera_af,
           pruning, weed_control, tillage, 
           pest_control, burning, litter_management, 
           fertilizer, irrigation, grazing,
           avg_veg_height_m, avg_wood_dens_g_cm3,
           avg_leaf_area_mm2_mg, avg_root_depth_m,
           n_fix_bin, myco_fungi_am, myco_fungi_ecm,
           freezing_exposed, resprout_after_fire) 
} else if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  final_df <- comb_df %>%
    select(row_id, ssp_id, ssp_id_mult, c_t_ha_yr, 
           depth_min, depth_max,
           af_cat, age_min, age_mean, age_max, 
           prior_land_use,  ctrl_cat,
           country,
           ipcc_reg, audebert_zone, ecoregion,
           trees_per_ha = trees_per_ha_mean, 
           masl, map, mat, 
           soil_texture_class,
           sand_pct = sand_pct_mean,
           silt_pct = silt_pct_mean,
           clay_pct = clay_pct_mean, 
           af_diversity = af_diversity_mean,
           species_af,
           genera_af,
           pruning, weed_control, tillage, 
           pest_control, burning, litter_management, 
           fertilizer, irrigation, grazing,
           avg_veg_height_m, avg_wood_dens_g_cm3,
           avg_leaf_area_mm2_mg, avg_root_depth_m,
           n_fix_bin, myco_fungi_am, myco_fungi_ecm,
           freezing_exposed, resprout_after_fire) 
}

final_df <- final_df %>%
  left_join(comb_df_prior_dummy) %>%
  left_join(comb_df_soiltex_dummy) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(., is.nan(.), NA))) # replace NaN with NA for output formatting

if (c_data_name == 'soc_change') {
  final_df <- final_df %>%
  left_join(comb_df_ctrl_dummy) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(ssp_id = ssp_id_mult) %>% # reset ssp_id to version that may include multiple
    select(-ssp_id_mult)
}

write.xlsx(final_df, paste0(here("output", "data"), "/", c_data_name, '_by_plot_and_age_w_covars.xlsx'))

```
